'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] attack the [[Shevchenkivskyi District, Kyiv]], and an energy facility in the city of [[Sumy]] with [[HESA Shahed 136]] [[Loitering munition|suicide drones]], killing eight people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-63280523 (BBC News)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/10/17/kyivs-central-district-rocked-by-blasts-for-the-second-time-in-week.html (CNBC)]
***The [[European Union]] establishes [[European Union Military Assistance Mission Ukraine|EUMAM Ukraine]], a special military mission that will provide training for the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian Armed Forces]] in EU member states. [https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2022/10/17/ukraine-eu-sets-up-a-military-assistance-mission-to-further-support-the-ukrainian-armed-forces/ (Council of the EU/the European Council)]
*[[Mali War]]
**After killing hundreds of civilians and forcing thousands to flee, the [[Islamic State in the Greater Sahara]] is reported to have captured the town of [[Ansongo]] in eastern [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamist-militants-mali-kill-hundreds-displace-thousands-eastern-advance-2022-10-14/ (Reuters)]
**Four [[Chad]]ian [[United Nations peacekeeping|United Nations peacekeepers]] are killed and two others are injured in a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bombing]] near [[Tessalit]], [[Kidal Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-rises-four-un-peacekeepers-killed-mali-attack-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Shire in the Tigray War]]
***[[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian government forces]] capture the city of [[Shire Inda Selassie|Shire]] from the [[Tigray Defense Forces]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/ethiopian-army-captures-large-city-from-tigray-forces-sources/ar-AA13344d (Reuters via MSN)]
*[[2022 Haitian crisis]]
**[[Secretary-General of the United Nations|United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] calls for "armed action" to establish a [[humanitarian corridor]] in [[Haiti]], saying [[Haitians]] face a "nightmarish situation", especially in the capital, [[Port-au-Prince]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/17/un-chief-calls-for-armed-action-in-haiti-as-crisis-persists (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Sri Lanka]]n writer [[Shehan Karunatilaka]] wins the [[2022 Booker Prize]] for his novel ''[[The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida]]''. [https://edition.cnn.com/style/article/booker-prize-2022-winner-karunatilaka-sri-lanka-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Yeysk military aircraft crash]]
**A [[Sukhoi Su-34]] crashes into an apartment building in [[Yeysk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]], killing at least 15 people and wounding 19 more. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2022/10/military-plane-crashes-into-apartment-building-in-yeysk-russia/ (BNO News)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/10/17/fighter-jet-crashes-into-residential-building-in-russia-a79110 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*The death toll from the ongoing [[flood]]s across [[Nigeria]], which started in early summer, increases to more than 600. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-63280518 (BBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 Uganda Ebola outbreak]]
**[[President of Uganda|Ugandan President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] places the capital city of [[Kampala]] under high [[Ebola]] response alert after two people who travelled from [[Mubende]] tested positive, with one of them later dying, amid an outbreak of the disease in the country. [https://english.news.cn/20221017/9dd7322848a04de995eff6b6da20e3d0/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] sanctions [[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]], [[Basij|Basij paramilitary military]], and its [[Guidance Patrol|morality police]] in response to the repression of the [[Mahsa Amini protests]]. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/iran-eastern-states/1666010178-eu-sanctions-iran-s-morality-police-minister-and-irgc (i24 News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Aftermath of the [[assassination of Shinzo Abe]] 
**[[Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Fumio Kishida]] orders an investigation into the ties between the [[Unification Church]] and members of the ruling [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]] amid heavy scrutiny of the claims of Abe's assassin. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/17/japans-pm-kishida-orders-probe-into-unification-church (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Ballon d'Or]]
**[[Karim Benzema]] wins the [[Ballon d'Or]] for the first time in his career after winning the [[2021–22 La Liga]] and the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League]] with [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] as well as the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League]] with [[France national football team|France]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/63288656 (BBC Sport)]
**[[Alexia Putellas]] retains her [[Ballon d'Or Féminin|Women's Ballon d'Or]] title, after scoring 18 goals for [[FC Barcelona Femení|Barcelona]], who [[2021–22 Primera División (women)|won all 30]] of their [[Liga F|league]] games [[2021–22 FC Barcelona Femení season|this season]], as well as the [[2021–22 Copa de la Reina de Fútbol|Spanish Cup]] and [[2021–22 Supercopa de España Femenina|Super Cup]], and also reached the [[2022 UEFA Women's Champions League Final|Women's Champions League final]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/oct/17/ballon-dor-2022-awards-karim-benzema-alexia-putellas (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 San Diego Open – Women's singles]]
**World number 1 [[Iga Świątek]] wins the [[WTA 500]] title in [[San Diego]], her 8th title this year, beating [[Donna Vekić]] 2–1 (6–3, 3–6, 6–0) in the [[2022 San Diego Open|San Diego Open]] final. [https://www.tennis.com/news/articles/stat-of-the-day-iga-swiatek-wins-eighth-wta-title-of-year-in-san-diego (Tennis.com)]
*[[Wasps RFC]] enter [[Administration (British football)|administration]] with all players and staff being designated as redundant and the team being formally relegated from the [[2022–23 Premiership Rugby|Premiership]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/17/wasps-relegation-administration-players-redundant-rugby-union-premiership (''The Guardian'')]
